messages:
Maya Chen: hey everyone! i'm Maya — joining infra as a SWE. first day today, excited to meet y'all. based in SF, 🇺🇸. coffee > tea, big bouldering nerd, and my dog Pinto will approve of any office treats :dog:
Jess Rivera: welcome Maya!! :tada: so glad to have you. ping me if you want a tour of the infra repos. also there's a new-hire lunch today at 12:30 in the cafe (i'll add you) :salad:
Sam O'Neil: hey Maya — welcome! curious — preferred dev env? mac or linux? any perf hobbies? :grin:
Maya Chen: thanks! I use mac for day-to-day, but run containers for testing. love perf tooling — flamegraphs are my therapy 😅
Lina Park: hi Maya! I'm your onboarding buddy. i've added a slack huddle for 3pm if that works. also i have a checklist if you need help with access: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/checklist (people-ops link) :sparkles:
People Ops: Welcome @Maya Chen! Your laptop provisioning is scheduled, and HR forms are in your email. FYI the benefits orientation is Friday at 10am.
DevX Bot: checklist: GitHub access ✅, VPN invite sent ✅, Dedicated Slack channels joined ✅
Maya Chen: sweet, thanks all. Lina — 3pm works. Jess — lunch yay. Also any good coffee recommendations near HQ? I live two blocks away but haven't explored yet.
Sam O'Neil: bluebird coffee across the plaza is our team's unofficial HQ :coffee:
Jess Rivera: +1 Bluebird. Also, if you like bagels, 'Two Rings' has an everything bodega bagel that fuels builds :bagel:
Lina Park: will DM you on calendar invite. Welcome again! :wave:
